narrative_purpose: Shows the enzyme's two possible outcomes side by side, so the reader sees that photorespiration is not a separate process but the same machine producing a broken product that must be salvaged at a loss.
subject: A split-panel comparison of the same large folded enzyme shape, drawn twice, each with an open pocket at its centre. Left panel: a small round gas particle has entered the pocket and an intact continuous chain of six linked molecular beads emerges from the far side, glowing evenly and unbroken. Right panel: a slightly different small gas particle has entered the same pocket, and what emerges is a short snapped stub of two beads with a ragged broken end, being carried away along a side path while a single small particle escapes upward off it as a wisp.
scene: Two paired molecular studies side by side against deep dark, divided by a thin band of haze, presented as two outcomes of one experiment.
camera: A straight-on paired study view, both enzyme shapes at identical size and orientation for direct comparison.
light: Internal glow from the molecular products themselves — steady and even on the left, weak and uneven on the right; the enzyme bodies lit only faintly from within by their contents.
palette: Void-indigo ground; left panel's intact chain in living teal and Pandora cyan; right panel's snapped stub and escaping wisp in biolum magenta; enzyme bodies in desaturated deep teal and stone.
style: Painterly speculative-biology naturalist plate, hand-painted texture, molecular structures painted as physical objects rather than as chemical notation.
detail_level: Crisp on the pocket, the entering particle, and above all on the difference between the intact chain and the snapped stub; backgrounds soft.
composition: Two equal vertical panels with a dark central seam, the products emerging toward the outer edges, a clear dark region above each enzyme for overlaid callouts.
consistency_notes: Cool Pandora palette with magenta reserved for the failure product; the left side must read as clean and productive and the right as broken and costly.
negative_prompt: no text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no chemical formulae, no ball-and-stick diagrams, no reaction arrows, no diagram labels, no leader lines, no photographic or 3D-render look, no lens flares, no neon UI glow, no cartoon or anime style, no vector flat design
